title: Wild AG intro curtain
description: A full-window intro curtain: a paper card with big round corners inset on the taupe-to-sand gradient, the gradient wordmark at its centre. On load the wordmark wipes in from the left, holds, and then the whole curtain lifts up out of the window, revealing the page (5.9s in all).
notes: fixed over everything (z-index 100) and click-through; it hides itself when done
CSS only; under reduced motion it isn't shown at all
duration (seconds) sets the whole sequence; the original takes 5.9s
name: wild-ag-loader

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the brand name shown on the curtain

props.name: duration
props.description: seconds for the whole sequence (wipe in, hold, lift away)
